closed_case_correction: For N_T>0 and s=t, require s in ACTIVE(T); otherwise connected ACTIVE(T) may live away from the prescribed basepoint.
connectivity_definition: Every pair of active packets is joined by a finite sequence of active packet identities whose successive pairs satisfy ~_T. No metric, length, edge geometry, or shortestness is introduced.
necessity: Any realizing raw history visits its used transitions in one ordered history, so every active packet lies in the same symmetrized positive-support component containing the history endpoints.
positive_support_relation: For x,y in ACTIVE(T), x ~_T y iff T(x,y)+T(y,x)>0.
sufficiency_dependency: Together with positive-entry adjacency typing, endpoint balance, and the closed-basepoint activity clause, this relational connectivity is sufficient by the finite token-splicing construction.
zero_case: For N_T=0 the support is empty and is not used; realizability is exactly s=t.
